items.question: How do I install Decoupage Screenwriting?
items.answer: Get it from the Mac App Store — it installs and updates like any other Mac app. It runs on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or later) on macOS 15.6 or later.

items.question: Is there a subscription?
items.answer: No. Decoupage Screenwriting is a one-time purchase — buy it once, it’s yours. No monthly fee, no account required.

items.question: Where are my scripts stored?
items.answer: On your Mac, in document files you own (.dcpg). Nothing is locked in a cloud account.

items.question: Is my writing private? How does the AI work?
items.answer: On-device reads run entirely on your Mac — nothing leaves your device. Deeper cloud reads are always opt-in and clearly labeled.

items.question: Can I import my existing scripts?
items.answer: Yes — import Fountain, Final Draft (.fdx), and Highland files, and export the same formats.

items.question: I found a bug or have a request.
items.answer: Please send it below — it goes straight to the developer, with your email so you get a reply.
